latest_live_post.title: The First Two Weeks Decide Whether a Client Stays. Most Founders Waste Them.

review_state.title: You Tried AI and It Didn't Stick. The Problem Wasn't the Tool.
review_state.description: Most AI experiments quietly disappear — not because the tool failed, but because no one wired it into the actual work. Here's what makes AI stick.
review_state.preview_text: You ran the trial. Maybe it was a chatbot for your inbox, a drafting assistant for proposals, or a tool that promised to summarise every meeting. The demo was genuinely impressive — it did in seconds what usually eats your afternoon. You told the team, everyone nodded, and for about a week it felt like the future had arrived early.
